fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the main driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of approach.
• Keep all parking areas clear of vehicles when possible to allow responder staging and turnaround space.
• Mark or label each access point so responders can quickly identify which entry leads to which part of the property.
• Keep the front entry walkway clear of obstructions to allow direct responder approach to the main door.
• Designate and keep clear a consistent area within the parking zones for emergency vehicle turnaround given the limited space available.
